name: fishing-rod-reel
comment: WP-2.6. ItemFishingRod.onItemRightClick with a bobber out (use_item on stone: nothing placed, then sendUseItem). Stone y 59-60 with still water at x -4..4, z -14..-3; the player (id 0) at (0.5, 61, 0.5) holds a fishing rod. The bobbers are the harness's FishingHook spawns (EntityFish(world, player), whose constructor draws are replayed on the seeded stream; the rod's own cast is not used, its bobber's heading is unseeded in the oracle). t 1: a bobber cast +z (pitch 45) lands on the stone; t 40: the rod reels it in: EntityFish.catchFish gives 2 from the ground, the rod wears 2 and the arm swings, the bobber dies and fishEntity is cleared. t 42-43: turned to -z (pitch 30), a second bobber lands in the water and bobs (its bite timer draws its own rand); t 200: reeled in, the rod wears by catchFish's result (a fish item flies to the player if one was biting).
